messages:
Carlos S: FYI — FinEdge asked for tenant-level tracing hooks + per-tenant cost-insights in Console. They want: per-route trace links to traces from a console dashboard, and a cost breakdown widget by model/version and route. They flagged compliance need for pinned retention and audit links.
Elena M: thanks. Can you paste the customer ask and priority? do they need sampling controls or full traces? any timeline? :thinking:
Carlos S: Short version — they want trace links from a Cost Trace drilldown so support can jump to the full request trace. Sampling ok if we can guarantee linkability for sampled traces. Timeline: pilot in 8 weeks. QBR ask.
Sophia L: opened support ticket #7821 and sales RFP attached. They've requested per-tenant cost breakdown for last 30d + per-route latency percentiles. Multiple seats asked for RBAC.
Mike R: couple of concerns: full traces for all tenants at 1% sampling may still be large. We'll need trace correlation IDs in telemetry and an index to map cost slices -> traces. Also need to mirror trace retention vs console retention (cost storage cheaper).
Elena M: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) Console can show cost breakdown by tenant & route with a drilldown that links to a trace for at least 90% of top routes (with sampling 0.5–2%). 2) RBAC for tenant admins. 3) Dashboard + export CSV. Any objections?
Mike R: Implementation idea: instrument gateway to emit trace_key + tenant_id + route metadata, send lightweight index to cost pipeline (Kafka topic). Separate storage for trace pointers. We'll need quotas and backfill plan. Estimate: 3 sprints + one infra sprint.
Carlos S: customer will accept pilot limited to 3 tenants if we can show links. They're flexible on sampling. :thumbsup:
Elena M: OK. I'll add to backlog as `console: tenant-trace-index` with priority P2 and acceptance criteria above. Need eng estimate and SRE sign-off. Mike, can you post rough estimate by EOD tomorrow?
Mike R: Yup — will post numbers.
infra-bot: Design doc draft uploaded: https://redwood-internal/drive/console-trace-index/draft
Sophia L: tagging other customers who've asked: FinTrust, Equinox. I'll consolidate asks into the ticket.
Elena M: thanks everyone. moving to triage board.
